versions.changelog:
guaikei-xhs-explorer 1.0.0

- Initial release providing a comprehensive command-line tool for exploring and analyzing public Xiaohongshu (小红书) data.
- Supports keyword search, note detail and comment retrieval, creator post monitoring, and note comment extraction.
- Includes structured outputs for downstream analysis, reporting, and trend discovery.
- Requires configuration of a GUAIKEI_API_TOKEN for API access.
- Detailed documentation on usage, routing rules, data boundaries, and typical scenarios included in SKILL.md.
